item.title: Georgia election review panel recommends gradual shift to hand-marked ballots
item.description: After six lengthy hearings around the state last year, a special legislative committee studying the elections process has recommended incremental changes to Georgia’s voting system. The post Georgia election review panel recommends gradual shift to hand-marked ballots appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Chemical Technology advisors earn Augusta Tech Advisory Board of the Year honor
item.description: Augusta Technical College honored the advisors for its Chemical Technology program with the school’s Advisory Board of the Year Award during the annual Advisory Boards Breakfast with the President on Jan. 27 at First Baptist Church in Augusta. The post Chemical Technology advisors earn Augusta Tech Advisory Board of the Year honor appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Called Augusta charter meeting canceled due to lack of quorum
item.description: A called Tuesday meeting of Augusta’s Charter Review Committee had to be canceled Tuesday due to the lack of a quorum. The post Called Augusta charter meeting canceled due to lack of quorum appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: QTS unveils more about Gordon Highway data project
item.description: Augusta’s incoming data center on Gordon Highway will feature a development director from the area and create an estimated 160-220 permanent jobs. The post QTS unveils more about Gordon Highway data project appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County Board of Commissioners approve two out of three data center projects, Byrd Farm voted down
item.description: In what may be an unexpected turn of events, the contentious data center development projects proposed in Columbia County’s fourth district has concluded, at least for now, with only two of the three proposed projects having been granted rezoning to Data Center (D-C) zoning. The post Columbia County Board of Commissioners approve two out of three data center projects, Byrd Farm voted down appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Gang of Lake Olmstead members arrested in Augusta drug and gun investigation
item.description: Two Augusta men were arrested Tuesday night following a multi-agency operation targeting gang-related activity, according to the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office. The post Gang of Lake Olmstead members arrested in Augusta drug and gun investigation appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Basketball brawl forces suspension of Lakeside vs. Greenbrier game
item.description: A boys’ basketball game between Lakeside High School and Greenbrier High School was suspended Tuesday night after a fight broke out between players during the third quarter. The post Basketball brawl forces suspension of Lakeside vs. Greenbrier game appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Board overturns Augusta procurement official’s firing
item.description: Augusta’s interim procurement director for 11 months is getting a second chance to keep his city job after appealing to the personnel board. The post Board overturns Augusta procurement official’s firing appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Mayor to deliver ‘State of the City’ address Thursday
item.description: Mayor Garnett Johnson will deliver his 2026 State of the City address Thursday during a meeting of the Exchange Club of Augusta. The post Mayor to deliver ‘State of the City’ address Thursday appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County passes two out of three rezonings for data center requests amid persistent opposition
item.description: Some 17 speakers out of a packed house spoke before the Columbia County Board of Commissioners (BOC), Tuesday night, to urge the county to deny three rezoning requests for data center developments in District 4. The post Columbia County passes two out of three rezonings for data center requests amid persistent opposition appeared first on The Augusta Press.
